d: An anthropomorphic fox with cinnamon-brown fur and an adult, cunning expression. The figure has pointed, golden-brown eyes and a lean build, wearing a dark brown cloak over a white tunic and dark trousers, secured by a brown leather belt. Large, pointed fox ears emerge from a mane of shaggy, reddish-brown hair, while the character carries a heavy crossbow and a small glass vial of turquoise liquid. BODY COLOR: Cinnamon-brown LEGS: Digitigrade with dark brown paws.
